head: Send photos from iPhone to Mac with a flick: new app Zas
dek: Zas sends a photo from your iPhone to your Mac when you press, hold and drag it to the top edge of the screen. The $2.99 app came out on 20 November and was #54 in paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: You can send one photo or several, and videos in their original quality. Files go the other way too: drag them to the bottom edge of the Mac's screen and they land on the iPhone. It works over your local network without a server, the devices pair with a QR code and the connection is encrypted, according to the listing. One purchase covers iPhone and Mac, where it sits in the menu bar.
where: App Store, iPhone, iPad and Mac (iOS 18 or later), $2.99
means: If you move photos from your iPhone to your Mac often, Zas does it with one gesture, without cables or cloud uploads. Both devices have to be on the same network.
todo: Look at the App Store listing; it's a one-time $2.99 purchase for iPhone and Mac.
thumb_words: FLICK PHOTOS FROM IPHONE TO MAC
